data.definition: The section where raw data is broken down into detailed charts, graphs, and trends. It allows you to deeply understand the context, demographics, and underlying patterns behind the conversations.
A comprehensive view of all collected raw data. In this section, you can filter, sort, review, and export your project's complete dataset for external reporting.
The specific dashboard section displaying every individual post, article, or comment where your tracked keywords are used across the web and social media.
An overview page providing a high-level snapshot of your project's performance. It features key metrics, total conversation volumes, and quick insights at a glance.

Gunakan Pencarian Boolean untuk mempersempit hasil dalam proyek Anda. Ini sangat berguna saat melacak kata kunci luas seperti Tesla yang menghasilkan banyak penyebutan. Anda dapat menggabungkan kata kunci dengan operator seperti Required Keyword, atau Exclude Keyword untuk mendapatkan hasil yang lebih spesifik.
The specific digital platforms, websites, or social media channels (e.g., Instagram, X, TikTok, news portals) from which the system crawls and collects conversations.
The emotional tone or attitude detected within a conversation. Our AI automatically categorizes conversations as Positive, Neutral, or Negative to help you gauge public perception.
The individual user, account, or publisher who created the content. "Influencers" specifically refer to authors who have a significant follower base or high impact on the digital conversation.
Notifikasi yang dikirim ke email Anda ketika ada lonjakan penyebutan atau jangkauan. Anda dapat menyesuaikan kapan dan seberapa sering Anda menerimanya.
